claim_boundary: This adapter computes an engineered causal temporal comparison from the benchmark's modeled left/right antenna transduction. It is not a measured neural signal, not a claim that MaleCNS contains this exact computation, and is not a controller input in the sealed v1 experiment.

sensitivity_analysis.interpretation: This grid measures whether descriptive replay conclusions are fragile to nearby engineering thresholds. It must not be used to choose a threshold that improves navigation, event counts, or a future scientific claim.

qualification.claim_boundary: Qualification is controller-free. It tests whether the engineered comparator recognizes known bilateral latency and whether the current stochastic-puff benchmark supplies resolvable timing information to a fixed bilateral probe. It cannot establish a biological circuit mechanism or select navigation parameters.

heading_semantics.1.5707963267948966: antenna baseline aligned with +x; mean downwind transport should encounter left then right
heading_semantics.-1.5707963267948966: antenna baseline aligned with -x; mean downwind transport should encounter right then left
heading_semantics.0.0: antenna baseline crosswind; negative-control orientation for dominant +x advection

stop_rules: traveling-edge assay must produce at least one qualified directional estimate for every prespecified latency and both directions
every qualified traveling-edge estimate must have the correct sign
if all longitudinal fixed-plume probes are directionally silent, the current plume/sensor stack is not eligible for functional-v2 escalation
qualification outcomes may not be used to retune the sealed estimator thresholds inside this protocol

direction_convention.definition: For each causal delay d, compare left(t-d)*right(t) against right(t-d)*left(t). Positive evidence means the left antenna led the right antenna at that delay.

scientific_controls: sealed v1 mean-odor interface remains unchanged
odor encounter/loss/reacquisition events use frozen hysteresis and a minimum dwell time
mirror left/right histories and require motion-evidence sign reversal
simultaneous bilateral pulses should produce near-zero direction evidence
prefix invariance proves future frames cannot change prior causal estimates
offline temporal misalignment must preserve the shifted antenna channel's marginal values exactly
offline circular shift is diagnostic-only and must never be described as a causal online sensory stream
threshold sensitivity is secondary robustness analysis only and cannot redefine the primary thresholds
controller-free traveling-edge and fixed-plume assays must precede any functional-v2 controller access
future v2 controller experiments must compare intact topology with equally optimized rewires and a temporal-information ablation

show: odor encounter, loss, and reacquisition markers
